g.text: Where does traffic occur as activity changes?

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #485760

g.text: Same geographic extent in every panel. Complete trajectories are shown, including long routes in the quieter windows.
Dashed band: ±0.8 km north–south offset from a GPS-derived ridge. It is a spatial reference, not active traffic or an official lane.
Peripheral means spatially dispersed relative to the corridor, not a short trajectory. Offset dots represent vessels; dark lines are medians.
